Product motion · Visual storytelling · Creative direction

Motion and Cinematic Product Storytelling

Campaign films, app-store previews, live-show openers and reusable product animation designed to make an unfamiliar commerce experience feel clear, energetic and worth joining.

Project typeProduct + Visual Design
ContributionCreative Direction + Motion
Year2017–2020
CompanyGravy Live

Selected campaign spot · Concept, visual direction, editing, sound design and motion production

The opportunity

Make a new behavior feel instantly understandable.

Gravy combined live entertainment, social interaction and commerce in a format most people had never used. Motion had to explain the premise quickly while creating anticipation around each show.

Creative approach

Use energy to clarify—not decorate.

I treated timing, typography, sound and product footage as one narrative system. Every piece needed a clear idea, a fast read and a recognizable Gravy personality.

Surfaces

One visual voice across the journey.

The work supported app-store discovery, paid social, prospective partner demos, live-show programming and lightweight in-product feedback.

Creative ownership from concept to delivery

My role spanned concept development, visual direction, editing, sound design and motion production. I created launch and campaign assets in After Effects and Audition, combining live footage, interface capture, typography and brand elements into concise product stories.

Inside the product, I used Airbnb’s Lottie, After Effects and Bodymovin to translate the same personality into lightweight, implementation-ready animation. That connection between campaign storytelling and product behavior helped the experience feel like one brand.

In-product motion

A reusable motion language inside the product

These moments were designed as a system rather than isolated decoration. Shared timing, expressive character behavior and lightweight Lottie delivery gave rewards and status changes a consistent Gravy personality while remaining practical to implement.
